json_enabled.description: Enable JSON formatting for listing outputs and errors.

outputs.description: List of output configurations to apply via wlopm commands. If empty, wlopm will just list outputs if json_enabled is false, or list in JSON if true, unless specific actions are defined. Note: wlopm is primarily a CLI tool; this config simulates a default set of operations or a startup script arguments list. For a service wrapper, this would define the arguments passed to wlopm.

items.description: Item description for the outputs list structure.

name.description: The name of the display output (e.g., 'DP-1', 'HDMI-A-1'). Compositor dependent.

action.description: The power management action to perform on the output. Must be one of 'on', 'off', or 'toggle'.
